tools.name: agent_teams_add_member
tools.description: Add a member to the team roster. Planning and idle roster rows do not call a model. After approval, the member session starts with its first ready task or explicit message and remains durable for later work.

name.description: Unique member name inside the team.

role.description: Role of the member (e.g. researcher, engineer, reviewer).

provider.description: Optional LLM provider route. Use only when the user explicitly requests a different provider; requires model. Omit to use the configured member route (memberLlmProvider/memberModel) or the captain's current route.

model.description: Optional model override (used verbatim, including any "/" in the id). Omit for the configured memberModel default (paired with memberLlmProvider when set) or the captain's current model.

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort override: one of the target model's supported effort ids, or "default" to force its default. When omitted, the captain's effort is inherited only for the same provider/model; a changed route uses the target default.

executionPrompt.description: Optional member-specific execution prompt. It remains editable while staged.

tool_policy.description: Optional id of a tool policy declared by the deployment owner (config toolPolicies). It restricts which global tools this member sees and may invoke: a policy allow-list also keeps the four coordination tools, and captain-only tools can never be reopened. Omit for the unchanged default tool set.

tools.name: agent_teams_amend_task
tools.description: Captain-only controlled contract amendment for one non-terminal quality task: replace a wrong objective/acceptance/verify/inScope/outOfScope when the original contract makes honest completion impossible (for example a verify command that cannot pass, or an inScope that forbids the file the objective names). The amendment is appended to the task's revisions ledger with previous values and the reason, and is rejected once a review/requirements task has passed judgment on this task. Members cannot amend contracts; the implementer re-reads the amended contract before its next quality gate. Lists are full replacements, not deltas.

task_id.description: Task whose contract is being amended.

reason.description: Why the current contract is wrong; recorded in the revisions ledger.

acceptance.description: Replacement acceptance criteria (full list, not a delta).

verify.description: Replacement verification commands (full list, not a delta).

tools.name: agent_teams_approve
tools.description: Approve and start a staged team plan. Call this only in response to an explicit user approval in a new user turn; never call it during the turn that created or edited the plan. The Web Approve & Run button uses the same runtime directly.

tools.name: agent_teams_claim_task
tools.description: Members claim their own ready task or read their existing attempt_id. Captains must use reassign_task to assign and wake a member; claim_task does not dispatch work. A member cannot own a second unfinished task. The returned attempt_id is required for updates and becomes stale after retry/reassignment.

assignee.description: Deprecated: claim_task only supports a member claiming its own task. Captains must use reassign_task.

tools.name: agent_teams_create
tools.description: Create a team. Use approval=required for a two-phase plan: members and tasks remain unspawned/unclaimed until the user reviews the Web plan and explicitly approves it. Optional profiles expand their configured roster; seed profiles also expand template tasks, while captain profiles leave the graph for the Captain to design. approval=automatic preserves the legacy immediate-execution path.

name.description: Name for the new team (used as its stable id).

description.description: Team purpose / the goal the team will work on.

plan.description: Optional complete ordinary-work roster and DAG in one atomic call, instead of separate add_member/create_task rounds. Mutually exclusive with profile. For quality gates use create_task with the explicit quality contract.

tool_policy.description: Optional owner-declared tool-policy id for this member.

id.description: Local reference used by dependencies in this plan; the result maps it to a durable task id.

approval.description: required stages the plan for explicit user review; automatic starts immediately. Defaults to automatic for API compatibility.

tools.name: agent_teams_create_task
tools.description: Create a task in your team's task list. Use kind=work (default) for research, repository audits and general tasks. kind=review is only a quality gate for an existing implementation/repair task via reviewedTaskId. Every call must include a non-empty subject, including verification and review tasks. Tasks can depend on other tasks (dependencies): a task is only claimable once every dependency is completed. Optionally assign it to a member, who still claims it before working.

subject.description: Required non-empty title for this task. Never omit it, including for verification or review tasks.

description.description: What needs to be done, in detail.

dependencies.description: Task ids this task depends on (must be completed before this task can be claimed).

assignee.description: Member name when an owner is specified. Omission puts this task in the shared pool; roles, subjects and descriptions do not assign an owner.

kind.description: Explicit task kind. Omission means work with no quality gates, even if the subject says implementation/review. Quality kinds require a contract. An implementation may be planned before requirements passes when its dependency chain includes that requirements task.

objective.description: Required non-empty objective for quality kinds.

inScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task may change.

outOfScope.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths this task must not change.

acceptance.description: Acceptance criteria. Required for quality kinds.

reviewedTaskId.description: Existing AgentTeams implementation/repair task id. Required for kind=review; an external repository audit is kind=work.

sourceFindingIds.description: Finding ids this repair must close.

coverageOf.description: User-constraint / goal items this task covers.

resume.description: If true, clear halted in the same lock before creating the task.

tools.name: agent_teams_delete
tools.description: End and archive your team: interrupts members and moves the current tasks and mailboxes out of active state for later inspection. Use when the work is done or explicitly abandoned. A same-name archive replaces its previous generation.

tools.name: agent_teams_edit_plan
tools.description: Atomically revise an AgentTeams plan. While staged, edit tasks and roster without starting work. While running, only update_task is allowed, and only for pending tasks with no prior attempt: correct dependencies, assignees or descriptions before they start; newly ready work is scheduled after commit. Never edit active/finished attempts. Submit dependent edits in order. Never modify .agent-teams files directly.

operations.description: One atomic, ordered batch. Running teams allow only update_task for never-started pending tasks. If any operation is invalid, none of the edits are saved.

member_name.description: Member name for update_member or remove_member.

task_id.description: Task id for update_task or remove_task.

subject.description: Required for add_task; optional replacement for update_task.

assignee.description: Optional task assignee; an empty string moves it to the shared pool.

dependencies.description: Complete replacement dependency list for a task.

provider.description: Optional member provider; defaults to the current staged route.

model.description: Optional member model; defaults to the current staged route.

tool_policy.description: Optional owner-declared tool-policy id for this member; an empty string clears it back to the unchanged default tool set.

tools.name: agent_teams_reassign_task
tools.description: Atomically retry, reassign, or let the captain take over one ready unfinished/failed task. The old attempt is revoked before its member is interrupted, so late updates cannot overwrite the new owner. Use assignee="captain" only when you will finish that task in this turn; a captain can own only one unfinished takeover at a time, and an unfinished takeover returns to the member pool when the captain becomes idle.

assignee.description: Active member name, or "captain" for captain takeover.

reason.description: Why the task is being retried or reassigned.

tools.name: agent_teams_remove_member
tools.description: Remove a member safely: revoke its current attempts, return all unfinished owned tasks to the shared pending pool, interrupt its live turn, and mark it removed.

name.description: Name of the member to remove.

tools.name: agent_teams_resume
tools.description: Explicitly resume a halted team. Requires a non-empty reason. Does not recreate cancelled tasks; only still-pending work is scheduled.

reason.description: Why the team is being resumed.

tools.name: agent_teams_send_message
tools.description: Send coordination or current-task guidance directly to the captain or a teammate. A running recipient receives it at the next model step; an idle recipient wakes. Messages are durably retained until read. Use task creation/reassignment for a new unit of work, not repeated status nudges.

source_task_id.description: Sender task, NOT the recipient task. Members include it with source_attempt_id. Captains sending guidance normally omit both source fields.

source_attempt_id.description: Sender execution capability paired with source_task_id. Stale reports are rejected. Omit for ordinary captain guidance.

from.description: Sender (defaults to the caller: the captain, or the calling member).

tools.name: agent_teams_status
tools.description: Team snapshot: members with live activity and tasks with status/assignee/dependencies/output. Captains also see every team mailbox; members see only their own inbox. Use after mailbox progress deliveries or for an explicit status request. After dispatch, end your turn while members work; do not repeatedly poll.

tools.name: agent_teams_update_task
tools.description: Update a task status/output. Members must supply the current attempt_id returned by claim_task; stale attempts are rejected after takeover/reassignment. Terminal results are immutable, but owners and the captain can append acceptanceResults/commandsRun/evidence_note as attributed supplemental evidence, without reclaiming or changing the verdict. A captain must use reassign_task(assignee="captain") before updating active member-owned work.

attempt_id.description: Members must explicitly include the current attempt_id from their assignment/claim in EVERY update, including failed reviews with findings. If omitted, retry with the same current id; omission does not revoke the attempt.

output.description: Original result summary; immutable after completion/failure.

evidence_note.description: Append-only supplementary observation on a terminal task. Does not reopen work or change the original result.

verdict.description: Required for completing requirements/review. needs_revision and reject must fail the task.

findings.description: Structured review findings. Required when verdict is needs_revision or reject; each item needs id, severity, problem, and requiredFix.

changedPaths.description: Workspace-relative POSIX paths changed by this implementation/repair.

acceptanceResults.description: Acceptance evidence in contract order: {criterion, status:"passed"|"failed", evidence?}. Supply one item per acceptance criterion.

commandsRun.description: Verification evidence in contract order: {command, status:"passed"|"failed", exitCode?, evidence?}. Supply one item per verify command.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.description: Ask the user a concise question when you need confirmation, a choice, or missing information before proceeding. An answer item with empty selected and no custom means the user skipped that question: continue without it, do not ask it again, and do not treat the skip as permission.

questions.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.

id.description: Stable id for this question; echoed in the answer.

question.description: The specific question to ask the user.

header.description: Optional short heading for the question, such as "Confirm" or "Choose Mode".

options.description: Optional choices to show the user. If you recommend one, put it first and append "(Recommended)" to that label.

description.description: One sentence explaining the tradeoff or impact.

multi_select.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false.

tools.name: bili_watch
tools.description: 用户给出 B 站视频链接 / BV 号，要我看、总结、判断这条视频讲了什么、有没有坑、值不值得看时使用。读取一个 B 站视频的内容材料（只读、匿名）。优先级：字幕 → 本地 ASR 转写 → 抽帧 OCR。command=peek：只拿标题/简介/热评 + 均匀 5 帧（需下载 360p 视频约每分钟 1 MB + 抽帧约 2 秒），用来先判断是口播还是画面，再决定走 text 还是 ocr；command=text 会按优先级自动降级并返回最可信的一份文本（推荐）；view=元数据与热评；comments=评论区；asr=强制本地转写；frames=抽帧（可加 ocr=true 顺带识别画面文字）；ocr=抽帧并识别画面文字；sub=只要字幕；search=按关键词搜视频（配 days 可只留最近 N 天发布的，结果按播放量降序，用来看「这几天有什么值得看」）；hot=综合热门榜（B 站按热度排的前 N 条）；danmaku=弹幕热区（观众在哪一段反应最集中，判断名场面在哪）；sheet=把 N 帧拼成九宫格一张图（看图省 token）；substrip=把底部字幕逐段竖拼成一张图（硬字幕视频最省）。多 P 视频用 p 指定第几个分P（默认 P1）。拿到文本后由你负责理解与总结。

command.description: 要看哪一类材料；想要「讲了什么」的原料用 text，想先看有什么可看的用 search/hot。

keyword.description: command=search 时的搜索关键词（如「DeepSeek」「AI 编程」）。

days.description: command=search 时只保留最近 N 天发布的（再按播放量降序）；不传则不限时间。

bv.description: BV 号（如 BV1xx411c7mD），或直接贴 B 站分享链接（https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV.../?...），会自动提取 BV 号。search/hot 不需要。

p.description: 多 P 视频的分P序号（1 起）；不传默认 P1。

step.description: 抽帧间隔秒数（frames/ocr/text 用）；不传则按视频时长自适应（长视频更疏，省 CPU）。

ocr.description: command=frames 时是否顺带识别画面文字。

fast.description: command=text 时跳过本地转写，字幕拿不到就直接抽帧 OCR（画面类视频更快）。

scene.description: command=frames 时按画面变化点抽帧（吸附到变化最多的时刻，比等间隔更准，默认关）。

grid.description: command=sheet 时的格子，如 3x3 或 4x4（默认 3x3）。

cred.description: 登录凭证 JSON 路径（sub/text 拿 AI 字幕轨用）。不传走匿名。

order.description: command=search 的结果排序：pubdate 按发布时间、click 按播放量；不传用默认综合抓取。

at.description: command=frames/sheet 精看某一刻，支持 750（秒）、12:30（分:秒）、12:30-13:10（区间）。

ffmpeg.description: ffmpeg 可执行文件路径；不传按 deps 目录 / PATH 依次找。

asrMax.description: 转写时长闸门（毫秒）；超过就只出画面描述，不跑本地转写。

noTime.description: text/sub 默认带 [mm:ss] 时间码，加这个退回纯文本。

format.description: command=sub 时可选 srt、json、md 或 txt（srt/md 带官方时间戳，md 的时间戳可跳回原片，txt 是一行一句）；command=text 时可选 json（含时间轴口径：字幕 exact，转写与 OCR 是估算）或 md；command=comments/danmaku 时可选 json（stdout 只有 JSON）。不传默认纯文本。

out.description: command=sub/text/comments/danmaku 且传了 format 时，把结果写到这个文件（只接受工作区内的相对路径）；不传打印到标准输出。

head.description: 只取前 N 字（text/sub/asr 用）。超过默认上限时返回摘要与全文路径；需要完整内容时传入该参数；command=comments 时由工具层按 head 截断回给模型的文本

full.description: 直接返回全文（text/sub/asr 用）。长视频文本较长，会占用较多上下文；仅在需要完整内容时使用；command=comments 时工具层放宽回传上限，CLI 直出全文

verify.description: command=text 时加一次钓鱼核对：抽首尾帧 OCR，和字幕比对，判断「字幕是不是和画面无关的诱饵」。默认不抽（省时间），遇到可疑字幕再用。

fresh.description: command=frames/peek 时强制重新下载与重新抽帧，忽略已有缓存（默认复用缓存）。只在怀疑缓存损坏/过期时用，会多花下载与抽帧时间。

limit.description: command=hot/search 的结果条数（hot 默认 10，search 默认 10）。

num.description: command=comments 时取多少条顶层评论（默认 10）；只管顶层根数，每根楼中楼显示几条由输出策略决定，不合并成一个数。

tools.name: canvas_state
tools.description: Inspect the current state of the image-gen workbench infinite canvas: what shapes are on it (generated images, hand-drawn strokes, text notes) and what is currently selected. Use whenever the user refers to "the canvas", something they drew or placed there, or a selection, and before view_canvas or edit_image with source=canvas_selection.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds. Use it when the direct human request is a long-running objective, even if the user did not say "goal"; not for single-turn work.

objective.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

max_goal_rounds.description: Optional positive safe-integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: create_skill
tools.description: Create a new local DSH skill in DSH_HOME/skills. Use only when the user explicitly asks to create or save a reusable skill.

name.description: Skill name; it will be normalized to kebab-case.

description.description: A concise routing description for when to use the skill.

body.description: Markdown instructions that form the skill body.

tools.name: create_worktree
tools.description: Create a new Git branch and worktree from a local commit, branch, or tag, then change this session's working directory to it. Uncommitted files stay in the source checkout. Existing names fail. Use working_directory with cd to leave; the checkout and branch remain.

name.description: New branch name, also used as the checkout directory: a few lowercase words joined by hyphens that describe the task, such as fix-login-retry. Omit to generate a unique name.

from.description: Local commit, branch, or tag to start from. Defaults to HEAD; no fetch is performed.

tools.name: dream_bridge
tools.description: 渡梦：把人工采纳且适用的经验桥接进项目 AGENTS.md 的 Dream 管理块，块外内容原样保留。缺省 mode:"preview" 只读看 diff；复核后 mode:"apply" 必须带 preview.expected.sha256；mode:"rollback" 带 backupId 恢复。仅允许 review.actor=human 的已采纳经验，且 scope 匹配当前项目或经人工确认的全局范围。

mode.description: preview=只读预览（默认）；apply=带 expectedSha256 落盘；rollback=按 backupId 恢复。

path.description: 目标文件（可选；缺省为执行上下文 cwd 下的 AGENTS.md，取不到 cwd 会报错不猜）。

lessonIds.description: 参与桥接的经验 id（必须 usable 且 scope 匹配；缺省=按 store 顺序自动选取资格通过者）。

expectedSha256.description: apply 必填：preview.expected.sha256 原样回传；新文件用 null；不符则 conflict 零写入。

previewId.description: apply 可带：preview.previewId，用于校验是同一份预览；块内容不一致 → preview-mismatch，需重新 preview。

backupId.description: rollback 必填：apply 成功返回的 backupId。

projectId.description: 当前项目 id（可选；用于匹配只带 projectId 的经验，纯增量）。

tools.name: dream_context
tools.description: 取梦：按当前任务返回少量真正适用的经验（只读，默认最多 5 条 / 3000 字符）。只返回 global 或与 projectId/workspaceRoot 精确匹配的经验；未知项目只返回 global，绝不跨项目扫描。rejected/stale/disputed 默认排除；候选默认不注入（candidate-hold），无独立证据且非 usable 不注入（no-evidence），版本条件与包名不符不注入（version-mismatch），skipped 均给原因。未审阅候选不得当作已证实结论；只有明确审阅候选时才传 includeCandidates=true。when/exceptions 完整保留，元数据可按预算截断，预算放不下即停。

query.description: 当前任务描述或检索关键词。

projectId.description: 当前项目 ID（可选；未知时只返回 global）。

workspaceRoot.description: 当前工作区根目录（可选）。

packageVersion.description: 当前相关依赖版本（可选；需配合包名被识别才参与版本判定）。

packageName.description: 当前相关依赖包名（可选；与 query 文本一起识别 applicability.package）。

platform.description: 任务目标平台（windows / linux / macos 等）；缺省从任务文本识别，否则使用宿主系统。平台不符的经验不注入。

includeCandidates.description: 是否把候选经验纳入任务建议（默认 false；仅明确审阅候选时传 true，无证据候选仍不注入）。

tools.name: dream_digest
tools.description: 入梦：回放最近会话的梦原料。读取 DSH 会话日志（多帧 zstd），返回最近 N 个会话的标题、轮数、用户原话摘录、助手结论尾段与工具足迹；自动跳过子代理会话。拿到摘要后请反思并用 dream_save 记梦。

maxSessions.description: 回放会话数（可选，默认配置值，上限 50）。

mode.description: 摘要模式：full（默认，全量原料）/ brief（仅意图与结论，省 token）。

tools.name: dream_health
tools.description: dsh-dream 自检：检查会话目录是否可读、梦境日记目录是否可用、梦境条数。遇到问题时先运行本工具定位。

tools.name: dream_journal
tools.description: 翻梦：倒序列出历史梦境日记（新梦在前）。做梦前先翻翻，避免重复做同一个梦。

tools.name: dream_learn
tools.description: 学梦：把一条可复用经验连同证据提交为候选。写清 title（一句话结论）、action（可执行动作）、when（适用条件）与 exceptions（例外）；会话证据需 sessionId+recordSeq 和可匹配的 quote（省略时用 summary），本地产物需当前工作目录内的 artifactPath。verification=read 必须通过插件实际核验；失败降为 claimed 并说明原因，不计独立支持。新经验均先留在 candidate，读到来源不代表用户采纳。

title.description: 一句话结论；脱离 when 不得单独使用。

when.description: 适用条件（何时该用）；检索时不可截断。

workspaceRoot.description: 项目工作区根目录（可选）。

global.description: 是否为显式全局经验（可选，默认 false）。

evidence.description: 证据数组（可选，缺省为空数组；无证据时只能保存为 candidate）。

sessionId.description: 会话 ID（session 证据建议提供）。

recordSeq.description: 记录序号（数字或字符串）。

quote.description: 来源可见正文中的原文片段；摘要为转述时必填。引用原文只用于核验，不持久化。

sourceHash.description: 可选的来源 SHA-256；插件自行计算并核对，不能只凭此值证明来源。

artifactPath.description: local-artifact 的文本路径；只能读取宿主当前工作区内文件。

verification.description: read=请求插件核验引用；找不到或不匹配自动降为 claimed。读取不代表用户采纳。

tools.name: dream_recall
tools.description: 忆梦：按关键词检索梦境日记（不区分大小写）。用户问起过往经验时先忆梦再回答。

tools.name: dream_review
tools.description: 审梦：建议采纳/驳回/标记冲突或过期/追加验证证据，必须带 expectedRevision。模型的 accept 与 resolve-conflict 只返回待人工确认的建议，不修改审阅状态；请用户在设置 → Dream 中确认采纳。attach-evidence 只追加证据，不自动改变 state。

lessonId.description: 经验 ID（accept/reject/mark-*/attach-evidence 必填；resolve-conflict 可用 targetId 替代）。

targetId.description: resolve-conflict：目标经验 ID（优先于 lessonId）。

affectedIds.description: resolve-conflict：受影响/对方经验 ID（缺省则用 conflictWith）。

expectedRevision.description: 期望 revision（乐观锁，必须与当前一致）。

evidence.description: attach-evidence 时使用的证据数组。

sessionId.description: 会话 ID（session 证据建议提供）。

recordSeq.description: 记录序号（数字或字符串）。

quote.description: 来源可见正文中的原文片段；摘要为转述时必填。引用原文只用于核验，不持久化。

sourceHash.description: 可选的来源 SHA-256；插件自行计算并核对，不能只凭此值证明来源。

artifactPath.description: local-artifact 的文本路径；只能读取宿主当前工作区内文件。

verification.description: read=请求插件核验引用；找不到或不匹配自动降为 claimed。读取不代表用户采纳。

conflictWith.description: mark-disputed：冲突对方 id 列表（双方互相登记且全部置 disputed）；resolve-conflict：要一起解析的对方 id（必须与之互为 conflictIds）。

resolution.description: resolve-conflict 必填：prefer=以 lessonId 为准；drop=放弃 lessonId；merge=并入 lessonId（对方 stale）。

note.description: resolve-conflict 必填的解析依据；mark-disputed 可选。

tools.name: dream_save
tools.description: 记梦：把反思写入梦境日记（永久保存）。reflection 用第一人称写感悟；lessons 列 1-5 条以动词开头的可执行教训；mood 是本次梦的心境（如 平静/兴奋/存疑）。严禁写入密钥与隐私。

reflection.description: 梦的反思正文（必填，第一人称）。

lessons.description: 1-5 条教训（可选，每条以动词开头）。

mood.description: 心境（可选，默认 平静）。

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `old_string` and `new_string` in the arguments.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit, combine, or restyle existing images with the configured provider. Images attached inline to the latest human message are already readable DSH attachments even when no workspace file exists. In that case, call edit_image immediately with prompt only (plus output options such as output_format=gif when the user wants an animation); NEVER call read_image, glob, or shell to locate them, and NEVER invent @ paths. All inline images will be used in upload order. For specific older conversation images use source_attachment_id or source_attachment_ids; both canonical sha256: IDs and full bare SHA-256 digests are accepted. For files the user explicitly names in the workspace use source_path or source_paths. For what the user selected or drew on the image-gen workbench canvas (for example a hand-drawn sketch) use source=canvas_selection; canvas_state can verify a selection exists first. Provide exactly one selector field. Without a selector, images from the latest human message take priority; only when that message has no images does editing fall back to the newest conversation image. When the user wants a person, character, or object from the reference images kept as the same identity, write short hard identity-preservation instructions (use the same subject from the references; do not redesign it or synthesize a similar-looking replacement; change only scene, clothing, pose, lighting, style, or composition) instead of long generic appearance descriptions, which make the model replace the subject with a synthesized lookalike.

prompt.description: Describe the changes to make while preserving everything else that should remain.

provider.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific image provider. Omission uses the saved default; never guess a channel or fill this with an empty string. Subscription providers edit through their logged-in accounts.

model.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific model; omission uses the configured model. Optional override for this call only. Not used by ComfyUI (use workflow instead) nor by the subscription providers (model fixed by the subscription).

channel.description: Optional configured OpenAI-compatible channel id for this call only. Only meaningful with provider=openai-compat; omit to use the active channel.

source.description: Use the current selection on the image-gen workbench infinite canvas as the reference image(s): full-resolution originals when the selection is conversation-generated images, plus a screenshot of the whole selection when it also contains other content (hand-drawn strokes, pasted images). Choose this when the user refers to what they selected or drew on the canvas; combine with no other selector field.

source_attachment_id.description: Optional attachment id of a specific image already present in the current conversation.

source_attachment_ids.description: Optional ordered attachment ids of multiple images already present in the current conversation. Prompt references such as image 1 and image 2 follow this order.

source_path.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative path of a specific image file inside the active session workspace. Prefer this when the user names a saved file.

source_paths.description: Optional ordered absolute or workspace-relative paths of multiple image files inside the active session workspace.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, subscription channels, and ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders (about one megapixel).

image_size.description: Optional output resolution for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Grok subscription (1K/2K), or Google subscription (1K/4K). NEVER send this for chatgpt-sub; omit unused fields entirely.

size.description: Optional output size for OpenAI, Seedream, or DashScope; WIDTHxHEIGHT maps to aspect_ratio for xAI Grok and sets the frame of ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders.

quality.description: Optional generation quality for OpenAI or compatible edits, independent of size.

workflow.description: Optional name of the ComfyUI workflow to run; omit to use the active workflow from settings. Only meaningful when the ComfyUI provider is selected. The source images fill the workflow's {{image}} inputs in node order, so pass as many images as it has inputs.

output_format.description: Optional. Only for provider=openai or openai-compat; gif animates the reference images into a looping animation, for example a sticker of the same character in motion. Omit size unless the user asks for exact dimensions: all frames are tiled into one sheet whose longest edge must stay at or below 3840 px. Many OpenAI-compatible relays do not implement image edits; if the relay rejects the edit or returns a still image, tell the user instead of retrying or assembling frames yourself.

frame_count.description: Optional, GIF only: number of frames, 2-16. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

frame_duration_ms.description: Optional, GIF only: milliseconds per frame, 20-2000; the provider rounds to 10 ms. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Find files and folders anywhere on this machine by name, through the local Everything index. Faster and far wider than scanning a directory tree, and it reaches folders that a workspace walk skips. Search by name or name fragment only — it cannot search file contents, so use grep for that. `path` confines the search to one folder and its subfolders. Use `limit` to page; the result says whether more matched.

query.description: File or folder name, or any contiguous fragment of one. Case-insensitive. Use `*` or omit it to list a folder.

path.description: Absolute folder to confine the search to, including all its subfolders. Omit to search every indexed drive.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return (default 50, at most 500).

tools.name: find_inspiration
tools.description: Search the bundled inspiration libraries for ready-made image prompts: the handdraw-style cookbook (styles 风格, layouts 排版, theme colors 单色) plus the awesome-gpt-image-2 example set. Use before generate_image whenever the user wants a specific art style, layout template, or theme color, mentions a numbered style like 风格 #123, or asks for reference or example prompts. Each hit carries a full prompt reusable with generate_image; handdraw style prompts contain a 主题 placeholder to replace with the user's topic, and may be combined with a layout and a theme-color prompt.

query.description: Keyword matched against titles, prompts, categories, and style/scene tags; Chinese or English. Omit to sample what a library offers.

category.description: Optional exact category filter, for example "风格 · D 日本作者 / 当代插画体系", "排版 · 信息图", or "单色 · 中性色系".

source.description: Optional single library to search; omit to search both.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of hits to return, 1-20 (default 8).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a new image with the configured provider. Use when the user asks to create or draw a new image; use edit_image instead when they want to change an existing image. Give a complete visual prompt including subject, composition, style, lighting, and any exact text that should appear. The optional provider/model arguments switch provider or model for this call only when the user asks for a specific one. A successful image is attached directly to the conversation and may also be saved under the session workspace. Do not call read, glob, or other tools to locate or verify the image.

prompt.description: Complete description of the image to generate.

provider.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific image provider. Omission uses the saved default; never guess a channel or fill this with an empty string. chatgpt-sub, grok-sub, and google-sub use logged-in subscription accounts instead of API keys.

model.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific model; omission uses the configured model. Optional override for this call only. Not used by ComfyUI (use workflow instead) nor by the subscription providers (model fixed by the subscription).

channel.description: Optional configured OpenAI-compatible channel id for this call only. Only meaningful with provider=openai-compat; omit to use the active channel.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, subscription channels, and ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders (about one megapixel).

image_size.description: Optional output resolution for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Grok subscription (1K/2K), or Google subscription (1K/4K). NEVER send this for chatgpt-sub; omit unused fields entirely.

size.description: Optional dimensions or size tier for OpenAI, Seedream, or DashScope; WIDTHxHEIGHT maps to aspect_ratio for xAI Grok and sets the frame of ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders. Do not combine with aspect_ratio; omit instead of using an empty string.

quality.description: Optional generation quality for OpenAI or compatible APIs, independent of pixel size (e.g. auto, low, medium, high). Omit to use the configured default.

workflow.description: Optional name of the ComfyUI workflow to run; omit to use the active workflow from settings. Only meaningful when the ComfyUI provider is selected.

output_format.description: Optional. Omit for an ordinary still image (the default PNG/JPEG); set it only when the user explicitly asks for an animation/GIF or a vector/SVG file. Only for provider=openai or openai-compat. gif produces a looping animation. svg produces one vector document that the conversation card can preview and save as a .svg file. For GIF, omit size unless the user asks for exact dimensions: all frames are tiled into one sheet whose longest edge must stay at or below 3840 px. To animate a subject from reference images, use edit_image with output_format=gif instead.

frame_count.description: Optional, GIF only: number of frames, 2-16. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

frame_duration_ms.description: Optional, GIF only: milliseconds per frame, 20-2000; the provider rounds to 10 ms. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

tools.name: generate_images
tools.description: Generate several images in one call, one per prompt, in order. Use for batches, variations, or illustration sets; prefer generate_image for a single image. Every successful image is attached to the conversation and may be saved under the session workspace. Items generate sequentially; a failed item is reported in the failures list and does not abort the rest. The optional provider/model/size arguments apply to every item.

prompts.description: Ordered complete prompts; one image is generated per entry (1-10).

provider.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific image provider. Uses the saved default for all items; never guess a channel or fill unused fields with empty strings.

model.description: OMIT unless the user explicitly requests a specific model for every item; omission uses the configured model.

channel.description: Optional configured OpenAI-compatible channel id applied to every item; omit to use the active channel.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, subscription channels, and ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders (about one megapixel).

image_size.description: Optional output resolution for Google Gemini, xAI Grok, Grok subscription (1K/2K), or Google subscription (1K/4K). NEVER send this for chatgpt-sub; omit unused fields entirely.

size.description: Optional dimensions or size tier for OpenAI, Seedream, or DashScope; WIDTHxHEIGHT maps to aspect_ratio for xAI Grok and sets the frame of ComfyUI workflows with {{width}}/{{height}} placeholders.

quality.description: Optional OpenAI or compatible generation quality, applied to every item independently of size.

workflow.description: Optional name of the ComfyUI workflow to run; omit to use the active workflow from settings.

output_format.description: Optional. Omit for an ordinary still image (the default PNG/JPEG); set it only when the user explicitly asks for an animation/GIF or a vector/SVG file. Only for provider=openai or openai-compat. gif produces a looping animation. svg produces one vector document that the conversation card can preview and save as a .svg file. For GIF, omit size unless the user asks for exact dimensions: all frames are tiled into one sheet whose longest edge must stay at or below 3840 px. To animate a subject from reference images, use edit_image with output_format=gif instead.

frame_count.description: Optional, GIF only: number of frames, 2-16. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

frame_duration_ms.description: Optional, GIF only: milliseconds per frame, 20-2000; the provider rounds to 10 ms. Omit unless output_format=gif; omit it then too to use the provider default.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running background job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

reason.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: job_list
tools.description: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.description: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished final-output job.

job_id.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

wait.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running. Defaults to false.

timeout_ms.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.name: list_mcp_resource_templates
tools.description: List parameterized resource URI templates from an MCP server.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by this server.

tools.name: list_mcp_resources
tools.description: List resources available from an MCP server.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor returned by this server.

tools.name: list_papers
tools.description: 列出文献库里的专题和文献。当用户提到某篇论文但你不知道它是否在库中、或用户问"我有哪些论文"时使用。

topic.description: 只看某个专题；省略则列出全部。

tools.name: list_subagent_models
tools.description: Inspect the routes available for explicit subagent model selection. No arguments: authorized providers. `provider`: that provider's authorized models. `provider` + `model`: that model and its reasoning efforts. Query when choosing an explicit child route or reasoning effort. Omit optional fields rather than sending empty strings.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: mcp__magpie-memory__memory_context
tools.description: Says who the memory server takes you for: the agent "only for you" is kept for, the project "this project" means, how each was found, and where a search looks. Check it before saving or moving memories for an agent or a project.

project.description: A project to check instead of the one you work in, as memory_search and memory_save take it

tools.name: mcp__magpie-memory__memory_forget
tools.description: Sets a memory aside when the user says it is wrong or no longer holds. It is kept for the user to look at, but no longer searched or given to agents.

tools.name: mcp__magpie-memory__memory_save
tools.description: Remembers one thing for later conversations, in every agent: what the user asks you to remember, a preference or rule they state, a correction they make, a fact about them or the project that will still hold next time. One fact per memory, written so it reads on its own. Don't save what is in the code or its history, a task's progress, or secrets. Memory is for what holds for the user across projects. A rule, convention or fact of one project belongs in that project's own instruction files or docs (AGENTS.md and the like) when it keeps them: offer to write it there instead, and don't save what they already say or what disagrees with them. Saving what is already remembered merges into it; with id, changes that memory.

id.description: A memory's id, to change that memory rather than save a new one

kind.description: profile: who the user is; preference: how they like things; rule: what must or must not be done; reference: where something is; fact: something true of a project; procedure: how something is done; episode: a decision or event worth recalling

project.description: Another project than the one you work in: its folder on this computer (absolute, or relative to yours), or its key as memory_context shows it (github.com/owner/repo)

scope.description: project: holds only in this project (default for facts, references, procedures and episodes); global: holds everywhere (default for profile, preference and rule); agent: only for you

tags.description: A few words to find it by (a topic, a tool, a language)

text.description: The memory, one self-contained fact or instruction

why.description: Why it holds, when the user said, so it can be judged later

tools.name: mcp__magpie-memory__memory_search
tools.description: Searches what is remembered from earlier conversations with the user, in any agent: their preferences, rules, facts about them and their projects, how things are done. Search before asking the user something they may have told you before, and when starting work in a project. With no query, lists the memories.

kind.description: Only memories of this kind: profile, preference, rule, reference, fact, procedure, episode

project.description: Another project than the one you work in: its folder on this computer (absolute, or relative to yours), or its key as memory_context shows it (github.com/owner/repo)

query.description: What to look for, in a few words

scope.description: project: this project's memories; global: those for every project; all (default): both, and yours

tags.description: Only memories with every one of these tags

tools.name: memory_dream
tools.description: 立即为本窗口安排一次记忆整理（dream）：把本窗口建立过/提取过的记忆逐轮发给主 agent 整理封存（第 1 轮=原子记忆 project/fact/lesson/rules/soul/user，第 2 轮=topic 记忆，第 3 轮=项目总结——仅当本窗口涉及具体项目时追加）。窗口空闲 3 小时以上自动触发（北京时间峰时 9-12 点/14-18 点及各自前 15 分钟不触发），此工具用于手动触发。

tools.name: memory_find_similar
tools.description: 按记忆 id 查找内容相似的条目（bigram 词频向量余弦）——用于查重、找冲突、判断某条记忆是否已有近似记录。 同样只检索其他会话建立的记忆，本会话已见（注入/检索过）的自动排除。

id.description: 基准记忆 id（memory_read/search 结果里的完整 id 或前 12 位）。

content_max.description: 每条内容截断长度，0=全文。

tools.name: memory_home
tools.description: 查看/切换 meow-memory 的全局数据目录（日志、梦境窗口账本等实例级数据的存放位置，记忆库本体在每个项目内、不受影响）。不带参数调用=返回当前目录与三个预设的实际位置；切换时会自动把旧目录内容整体搬过去（同盘为移动、跨盘为复制），跨盘复制时旧目录保留不删，需提醒用户确认后手动删除；若用户本机跑着多个 dsh 实例共享同一目录，请提醒它们应同步修改。当用户表示想把记忆数据/日志挪出 C 盘、换到别的盘或目录时调用。切换结果写在稳定位置指针（$DSH_HOME/storages/meow-memory-home.json），跨重启仍生效。

target.description: 目标位置。三选一传预设标记：default=系统用户主目录（默认）、dsh-storage=DSH 根目录 storages 下的 meow-memory、plugin-root=插件本体根目录下的 storage；或传一个绝对路径。不传=只查看当前状态，不做任何修改。

tools.name: memory_project
tools.description: 取回某个项目在记忆库中的完整注入段落（纯文本，按子标签分组，未过时条目一口气全给）。 project 参数必填：你要看哪个项目的信息？不传会报错，先想清楚项目名再调用。 当用户问起某个项目（femo/meow-memory/meow-eyes/dsh…）的设计历史、技术决策、用户原话、项目进度时调用； 也用于需要项目全景上下文再作答的场合。 规则：组内按记忆时间戳旧→新；todo 子标签输出「已完成：」（最近完成 5 条）+「To do list：」；每条记忆带完整 id、最后更新时间戳与原文。

project.description: 项目名（会话开头的记忆导引会列出用户的所有 project，直接选用）。

tools.name: memory_read
tools.description: 读取记忆库中某条记忆的完整内容（含 title/keywords/importance/状态等元数据）。

id.description: 记忆 id（注入块或 memory_search 结果里给出的 id）。

tools.name: memory_remember
tools.description: 把一条值得跨会话记住的信息写入当前工作区的记忆库（SQLite，按 level 分表）。 必填参数：content（内容）/ project（归属："全局"或项目名，多项目用英文逗号分隔）/ keywords（8-13 个检索关键词）/ importance（重要性评估）。缺失会报错并提示重填。 level 分类：soul=AI 自身（少用）；user=用户基本信息与基础偏好； project=项目（项目名如 femo/meow-memory/meow-eyes/dsh）； rules=设计原则/行为准则（全局准则 project 填"全局"且 importance≥2 会全量注入到首轮；  项目特定准则填 project 参数，随 memory_project 注入；其余走检索）； fact=细碎原子事实（一句话直陈 ≤60 字）；lesson=你学到的经验（被纠正的一定记这里）； topic=话题（建议 goal 目标句，用 keywords 检索）。 铁律：用户介绍项目设计思路/框架/决策理由时，content 必须保留用户原话措辞，不要转述总结。 与已有条目高度重复会自动合并（更新而非新增）。调用成功后工具会返回确认，无需重复调用本工具。

content.description: 要记住的内容；fact/lesson 一句话 ≤60 字；topic ≤300 字；涉及用户原话必须保留措辞。

project.description: 必填。项目名（level=project 时必须是具体项目名）；全局适用的信息填"全局"；同时适用于多个项目时用英文逗号分隔，如"dsh,femo"。

subcategory.description: project 子类：overview=目标概述/structure=项目结构/decisions=技术决策/quotes=用户原话/ops=部署与数据/todo=进行中。

goal.description: 话题目标句（level=topic 建议填，如"让 femGen 集成可用"）。

importance.description: 重要性（数字即可，不设上限；软引导 1-4：4=致命红线/健康安全，3=用户强调/全局适用，2=用户决策抽象总结，1=琐碎）。

corrected.description: 是否为用户纠正的内容（level=lesson 时）。

keywords.description: 手动指定关键词（反思/dream 轮要求提取 8-13 个内容词；不传则自动 bigram 提取）。

tools.name: memory_search
tools.description: 在当前工作区记忆库中检索记忆（BM25 × 近期权重）。 query 必填且不能为空——传你要查的关键词/句子，如 memory_search({query: "记忆插件 部署"})； 想浏览某项目全貌请用 memory_project（不需要 query），不要用空 query 调本工具。 结果构成（用户拍板）：默认 top 10 = 前 5 条按相关度无脑取（不排除任何记忆，包括已注入/已检索/本 session 建立的）+ 后 5 条从后续排名绕开已注入/已检索的记忆补齐（保证新信息）。 默认搜索范围=fact+lesson+topic+rules；level 支持逗号多选（如 fact,lesson）；想看项目全景传 level=project。 返回按相关度取 top-k 后按记忆时间戳重排（旧→新，供判断发展过程与新旧冲突）。

query.description: 检索关键词/句子（必填，不能为空；例："记忆插件 部署"）。

level.description: 限定层级，逗号多选：fact/lesson/topic/rules/project/soul/user（默认 fact,lesson,topic,rules）。

project.description: 按项目名过滤（逗号多选，OR 语义，如 "dsh,femo"；"全局"/未标记条目天然包含）。

status.description: 按状态过滤（逗号多选：active/archived/stale/all；默认 active，todo 类的 stale 视为已完成参与；含 all=不过滤）。

days.description: 只看最近 N 天创建的条目（按创建时间）。

content_max.description: 每条内容截断长度，0=全文。

explain.description: 可解释检索开关（默认关）。开=true 时每条命中附带分项得分 explain（bm25 关键词分、importance、recencyWeight 艾宾浩斯权重、status），用于排查"为什么没召回/为什么召回它"，不改排序。

tools.name: memory_update
tools.description: 更新记忆库中某条记忆（内容/重要性/状态/项目归属/话题目标句/关键词等）。 status 取值：active / stale（完结：todo 完成、话题达成目标 → stale 视为 done）/ archived（删除，过时作废/重复/被替代的条目）。

content.description: 新内容（topic 重写时用：起因经过发展结果 ≤300 字）。

importance.description: 新重要性（数字即可，不设上限；软引导 1-4：4=致命红线/健康安全，3=用户强调/全局适用，2=用户决策抽象总结，1=琐碎）。

project.description: 新项目名（project/fact/lesson/rules/topic）；全局信息填"全局"；多个项目用英文逗号分隔；传空字符串 = 清空归属（未标记）。

keywords.description: 手动指定关键词（发现不准时主动修正/补充；不传或空数组 = 不更新关键词）。

tools.name: modlens_read_image
tools.description: Read an image through the modlens vision bridge. Use whenever a message references an image the current model cannot see: a local file path or an http(s) URL to a screenshot, photo, chart, diagram, or document scan. Returns a summary, an outline of the layout regions in reading order, every word transcribed, and an uncertainty list. Quote the evidence instead of guessing. For the same image and focus, call this tool once and reuse its returned evidence instead of calling again. Evidence for a pasted image carries an `attachment-id:` line: to read that image again with a new focus, pass the id as path, and do not search the filesystem for the file. Requires a configured modlens engine: `npx @liustack/modlens doctor` checks the setup, and when a read fails, `npx @liustack/modlens -i <image file>` in a terminal shows why each provider failed.

path.description: Absolute local file path, http(s) URL, or the attachment-id (sha256:...) from pasted-image evidence

prompt.description: Optional extra focus for the reading (e.g. "focus on the axis labels")

tools.name: ops_bash
tools.description: Execute a Bash command in a fresh non-login shell. Use Bash syntax for quoting, $VAR, $(command), globs, redirects and pipelines; shell state does not persist between calls. On Windows this is a local MSYS Bash environment, not Linux, WSL or PowerShell. Execution uses the host sandbox, approvals and jobs. Relative workdir uses the current session workspace. Output is bounded with spill paths. Use command for short commands; script_path is an OPS extension for an existing Bash script file. description is required. Check kind: foreground includes status and exitCode; background/promoted includes jobId, not a completed exit. Failures return failure.code/effectState/retry; inspect unknown effects before repeating. Verify resolved absolute targets before delete or move. Never bypass a sandbox denial by switching shells. Start long-running processes and daemons with run_in_background; job_kill terminates the job's entire process tree.

command.description: Short bash command or pipeline. Omit or leave empty when using script_path.

description.description: Required: clear active-voice description of this command, 5–10 words.

script_path.description: Existing Bash script path, always executed by Bash regardless of extension. Use host pwsh for PowerShell scripts. Omit or leave empty when using command. Never use /dev/null as a placeholder.

workdir.description: Working directory, relative to the session workspace; defaults to that workspace when omitted.

timeoutMs.description: Defaults to 120000 ms; capped at 600000 ms. With host jobs, expiry hands the running command to job_output/job_kill; otherwise it stops the command.

graceMs.description: Grace period in milliseconds between termination and a forced kill. Defaults to 3000.

includeDiagnostics.description: Include compact timing and executor diagnostics in structured output; omitted by default.

run_in_background.description: Return a host job id immediately; collect with job_output and stop with job_kill. No execution timeout.

sandbox_permissions.description: After a real denial, request the narrowest wider mode for this exact command with justification. Approval applies only to this call. Do not bypass a rejection.

justification.description: One sentence explaining why this command needs wider access, in the user’s language. Required when changing sandbox_permissions.

tools.name: ops_discover_tools
tools.description: Select allowed built-in or external capabilities for the next model step in this scope; selection executes no tool action.

query.description: Capability or select:exact_tool_name (for example select:ops_stat or select:acme_lookup); 1-512 characters.

tools.name: ops_glob
tools.description: Find files (default), directories or both below path. Globs match paths relative to path: "*.md" matches the top level only, "!" excludes. Symlinks, reparse points, hidden files and dependency/build directories are excluded. Follow nextOffset; check scanComplete and pageComplete. matchedTotal exists only after a complete scan. Incomplete scans require a narrower query. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

path.description: Search root; relative to session cwd, default ".".

kind.description: Entry kind; default file. directory includes empty directories. ["*"] lists immediate children.

pattern.description: Glob ARRAY, e.g. ["**/*.md","!vendor/**"]; at least one positive entry is required.

outputMode.description: Paths (default) or paths with byte sizes and modification times.

sort.description: Path order (default) or newest modification first.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a complete scan. Keep query options unchanged; omit offset or use nextOffset. SEARCH_STALE requires a fresh query.

tools.name: ops_grep
tools.description: Search UTF-8 files below path. glob filters paths relative to path ("!" excludes); there is no include field. Searches exclude symlinks, junctions, reparse points, hidden files and .git. Use summary for aggregate file/match totals, count for per-file counts, files_with_matches for paths, content for text (default), or definitions for only the lines where the matched identifier is declared (function/method/type/variable/macro; lexical, not a parser; skips comment/string bodies; no multiline or context flags; matched counts all matching lines, total counts returned declarations). Follow nextOffset; each page rescans. Check scanComplete and pageComplete; matchedTotal exists only after a complete scan, matchedObserved is a lower bound otherwise. skipReasons explains gaps. Narrow incomplete scans instead of blindly paging. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

path.description: Search root; relative to session cwd, default ".".

glob.description: Relative glob ARRAY, e.g. ["**/*.ts","!vendor/**"]; "*.md" matches the top level only, "!" excludes. Omitted means all eligible files.

outputMode.description: Matching text (default), file paths, per-file counts, aggregate totals, or declaration lines for the matched identifier.

beforeContext.description: 0-32 inclusive. Lines before each match; default 0.

afterContext.description: 0-32 inclusive. Lines after each match; default 0.

multiline.description: Search whole-file text instead of individual lines; default false.

exactTotal.description: Default true. False stops at the row limit with lower bounds and no stable cursor; summary and continuation still scan fully.

continuation.description: Opaque cursor from a complete scan. Keep query options unchanged; omit offset or use nextOffset. SEARCH_STALE requires a fresh query.

tools.name: ops_inspect_local_file
tools.description: Read bounded UTF-8 text lines or a hex view from path relative to the DSH session cwd. Directories are rejected; choose a file. Failures resolve as {status:"error"|"rejected", error.code}; they are not thrown.

path.description: File path; relative to session cwd.

offset.description: 1-based line or 16-byte hex row; default 1. Legacy 0 also reads the first unit.

encoding.description: Text encoding; only utf-8 is supported.

tools.name: picgo_upload
tools.description: Upload local images or files to the user's configured image host with PicGo and return public URLs. Use this whenever a local file needs to become a link — inserting a screenshot into a README, blog post, or note; turning a generated chart into an embeddable image; sharing a PDF or zip as a download link. Uploads to whatever host the user already configured in PicGo (PicGo Cloud, GitHub, S3, and others). Do NOT use when the user named a specific destination (a cloud drive, object storage, npm, scp), or when they want to save a file locally or download a remote one. Returned URLs are publicly accessible — for a non-image file that looks sensitive, confirm before uploading.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the files to upload, in order. Relative paths resolve against the process working directory. Must not be empty — pass at least one file.

tools.name: plugin_manager
tools.description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

limit.description: List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

tools.name: ppt_absorb
tools.description: Inspect a local reference .pptx file OR batch-ingest a whole folder of curated/GitHub/corporate .pptx decks (corpusDir) offline via @office-kit/pptx. Extracts theme palette, fonts, master logo, chrome skeleton geometry, deep Taste Recipe, and reusable Slot-Filling Exemplar contracts (saved to .dsh-ppt/exemplars.json and .dsh-ppt/taste-recipes.json). 中文：只读深度吸收单份参考 .pptx 或批量投喂整个优质 .pptx 目录（corpusDir），自动过滤隐藏说明页、完成 WCAG 对比度净化，并沉淀为可复用的标杆范本契约与审美配方。

pptxPath.description: Local reference .pptx file path OR local directory of .pptx files to batch-ingest (relative to session cwd or absolute; read-only).

corpusDir.description: Optional explicit directory path of curated/GitHub/corporate .pptx files to batch-ingest into .dsh-ppt/exemplars.json & .dsh-ppt/taste-recipes.json (you may also pass a directory directly via pptxPath).

limit.description: Max number of .pptx files to ingest when batch-ingesting a directory (default 20, max 40).

extractLogo.description: Extract embedded master/cover logo as a PNG/JPEG data URI into sanitizedBrand.logo when present (default true).

saveTasteAs.description: Optional ID to save the absorbed deep aesthetic StyleRecipe into workspace .dsh-ppt/taste-recipes.json for one-click reuse via taste.

tasteName.description: Optional display name when saving the absorbed StyleRecipe.

saveExemplarAs.description: Optional ID to save the absorbed slide skeleton & brand DNA as a reusable Slot-Filling Exemplar in workspace .dsh-ppt/exemplars.json (reusable via exemplar).

exemplarName.description: Optional display name when saving the absorbed Exemplar.

tools.name: ppt_check
tools.description: Inspect a dsh-ppt JSON project without rewriting artifacts. Report revision, slide IDs, page-specific errors and warnings for dense text, estimated overflow, small table fonts, missing/low-resolution images, chart labels, contrast and unfilled template slots. Static estimates require final visual review in browser and PowerPoint/WPS. 中文：交付前检查工程，定位具体页的问题并给出修改建议，不改文件。

deckPath.description: Path to a dsh-ppt .json project, relative to this session cwd or absolute. Arbitrary external PPTX editing is not supported.

renderReceipt.description: Optional receiptPath returned by ppt_render. Rechecks current PPTX hash and every rendered output; never implies a visual pass.

tools.name: ppt_cite
tools.description: Attach verified academic citations from a dsh-cite library (.json/.jsonl), BibTeX (.bib) file, or inline BibTeX/DOIs to a dsh-ppt project. Resolves [@citeKey] and [doi:...] markers into slide.source footers and appends or updates a formatted References slide without inventing metadata. 中文：对接 dsh-cite 文献库或 BibTeX/DOI，自动将 [@citeKey] / [doi:...] 解析写入页脚并生成或更新标准参考文献页。

deckPath.description: Path to a dsh-ppt .json project, relative to session cwd or absolute.

citePath.description: Optional path to dsh-cite library.json, .jsonl, or .bib file. Auto-discovers workspace or ~/.dsh/data/dsh-cite/library.json if omitted.

dois.description: Optional verified DOI strings to resolve and cite.

citeKeys.description: Optional explicit citeKeys or DOIs to attach as citations.

style.description: Bibliography formatting style: gb-t-7714 (default), apa, mla, or chicago.

appendReferences.description: Append or update a References slide (default true).

expectedRevision.description: Use revision returned by ppt_create/ppt_check to prevent overwriting another edit.

saveAs.description: Save a new uniquely named copy instead of updating in place.

tools.name: ppt_create
tools.description: Generate a standalone HTML slideshow, editable 16:9 PPTX and JSON project from prepared Markdown or structured slides. Supports 24 themes, 6 master chrome skeletons, 20 Curated Gold Exemplars (8 built-in + 12 distilled from Apache-2.0/MIT/CC-BY-4.0 open-source GitHub decks + exemplar: "auto" semantic routing + workspace absorbed exemplars), Deterministic Weak-LLM Compensator & Anti-Slop Upgrader (autoUpgrade), Verified Evidence Ledger (evidence[] + evidenceAppendix + SLOP-13 fact-sourcing gate), 35+ native editable layouts & pro diagrams (KPI, Bento, mockup, syntax-highlighted code, Magic Quadrant, radar, dumbbell, heatmap, Marimekko, Sankey, SWOT, Porter value chain, Gantt, architecture, Harvey balls, TAM, org, Mermaid, booktabs), and deep .pptx absorption. 中文：先按 20 套标杆范本槽位组织内容或传入粗纲；零资料调研场景可附带交叉核验后的 evidence[] 证据账本与 evidenceAppendix，自动注入规范 source 脚注、演讲备注溯源卡、三线表附录页并通过 SLOP-13 事实出处门禁。

title.description: Deck title (used for the cover and file names).

content.description: Markdown content: # cover title, ## slides, -/* bullets (supports **bold** lead-ins), | ... | tables, > quotes, > [!TAKEAWAY] bottom summary bar, ::: kpi|cards|comparison|process|matrix|callout|gantt|architecture|harvey|tam|org blocks, and <!-- 备注: ... --> speaker notes. Required unless slides or template is provided.

theme.description: Visual theme id: auto (default: Scenario Auto-Director picks optimal theme & chrome) or swiss / velvet / data / soft / bold / consulting / cobalt-cream / exec-jilan / exec-palace / academic / editorial-forest / cartesian / course-sage / linear-dark / keynote-light / financial-ft / medical-clean / luxury-noir / bcg-emerald / economist-brief / venture-daylight / stripe-craft / aurora-stage / obsidian-amber. See ppt_themes.

taste.description: Curated Aesthetic Taste Recipe ID (mckinsey-partner | apple-keynote-dark | apple-keynote-light | swiss-editorial | linear-craft | ft-data-journal | nature-academic | oriental-zen) or a workspace-absorbed custom recipe ID.

exemplar.description: Curated Gold Exemplar ID ("auto" to match best of 20 curated + workspace exemplars; built-in 20: mckinsey-strategy | sequoia-pitch | stripe-product-launch | quarterly-exec-review | tech-arch-rfc | academic-defense | enterprise-proposal | gov-institutional | mckinsey-evolution | luxury-budget-review | swiss-bauhaus-workshop | dark-stage-investor | blueprint-ai-factory | warm-brand-story | ted-storytelling-keynote | msft-enterprise-discovery | daylight-earnings-research | okr-performance-review | quiet-canvas-keynote | medical-clinical-course) or workspace-absorbed ID. alignOrder.description: Re-sequence disordered draft slides to follow the active exemplar narrative arc (cover → thesis/KPI → problem → solution → quantitative proof → roadmap → closing) while preserving chapter boundaries. Default false.

autoUpgrade.description: Run deterministic Weak-LLM Compensator, evidence-anchored Action-Title synthesizer & Zero-LLM Self-Repair Loop (fixes title overflow, bullet walls, card/table overload, pie spaghetti, missing chart spotlight/takeaways, SLOP-01..12 before commit). Default true; set false to preserve raw slides verbatim.

persona.description: Optional scenario/audience persona for Auto-Art-Direction, layout rhythm promotion, and table/chart styling. Default auto.

referencePptx.description: Optional local reference .pptx path; absorbs its sanitized palette, CJK/Latin fonts, chrome skeleton, and master logo before applying explicit brand overrides.

cloneStructure.description: When referencePptx is provided, align generated slide archetypes and master chrome skeleton with the absorbed reference slideSkeleton[] where compatible (default false).

smartLayout.description: Enable or disable automatic multi-archetype Markdown layout promotion on >=4-section decks. Default true in async tool mode.

lang.description: UI language of the generated player: zh (default), en, or bilingual. Content language is whatever you write.

motion.description: Slide transitions plus bullet entrance animations: on (default) or off for a fully static deck.

dataModel.description: Optional explicit lineage and what-if model. Use with structured slides containing {{metricId}} in text/items/takeaway/tables or an exact token as chart values. Source facts reference a real cell or text line; assumptions require value/min/max/step. Formulas compute derived metrics. HTML offers live sliders; PPTX includes confirmed static values, formulas and assumptions in speaker notes. Leave absent for ordinary finished decks.

id.description: Letters and digits, starting with a letter; unique ID.

content.description: CSV/TSV or text content, combined sources at most 1 MiB.

path.description: Explicit local CSV/TSV/TXT/Markdown import path, relative to session cwd. Embedded once; no file watcher.

cell.description: A1 to Z500; first CSV row counts as row 1.

note.description: Explain the user assumption; do not invent factual provenance.

formula.description: Metric IDs, + - * / % **, parentheses and min/max/sum/abs/floor/ceil/round only. No JS property access or I/O.

evidence.description: Structured verified Evidence Ledger collected via external search & fact-checking. Automatically binds [E#] / evidenceIds to clean slide source footers, detailed speaker-notes provenance blocks, handout ledger table, and SLOP-13 fact-hygiene auditing.

id.description: Short uppercase evidence ID such as E1, E2, E3.

claim.description: Verified factual claim or quantitative metric.

source.description: Primary publisher, official report, filing, or paper name (never vague placeholders like "internet" or "网络整理").

scope.description: Geographic/segment scope or statistical definition (e.g. "Global", "中国大陆", "乘用车口径").

url.description: Optional verified http:// or https:// source URL (stored in speaker notes & handout).

note.description: Optional methodology caveat or cross-check discrepancy note.

evidenceAppendix.description: When evidence[] is provided, automatically insert a clean booktabs "Sources & Fact-Verification Ledger" appendix slide before the closing slide (default false).

outputDir.description: Directory to write the files into. Default: session working directory (or the plugin outputDir config).

fileName.description: Base file name for the three artifacts. Default: sanitized deck title.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing same-name HTML/PPTX/JSON trio. Default false: choose a unique numeric suffix instead.

tools.name: ppt_data
tools.description: Preview or confirm source/assumption changes in a data-enabled project. HTML remains interactive; PPTX is a confirmed static snapshot. Never invent provenance or silently treat assumptions as facts. 中文：预览来源更新或推演参数的影响，确认后保存可撤销副本；只允许更改声明的假设。

parameters.description: Declared input metric IDs to numeric values only.

sourceUpdates.description: Replacement content for existing source IDs; keep source type.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

用户要求：去 GitHub 和其他开源渠道深度调研，所有与个人台账、个人记忆经历云台账、经历整理相关的项目，全部认真收集，看看现有的有哪些。

用户偏好：
- 全程中文
- 深度调研
- 喜欢对比表格和 UI 卡片速查
- 不喜欢反复征求意见
- 涉及账号/额度倾向免费方案
- 安装习惯等

关键信息：注入的记忆提到 web_fetch 直连 Google 系/DuckDuckGo/r.jina.ai/search.brave.com 全部失败，但 curl 可达大量外网，GitHub api 搜 issues 可用，Google 官方页面 curl 可达。所以调研要用 curl / GitHub API，而不是 web_fetch。

这是一个深度调研任务，需要广泛收集信息。我应该用子代理并行去调研不同的方向，然后汇总。

任务范围：个人台账、个人记忆经历云台账、经历整理相关的开源项目。可以理解为：
1. 个人知识管理（PKM）/ 第二大脑：Obsidian、Logseq、Anytype、SiYuan、Notion 类开源
2. 个人经历/履历/成就记录：如简历、成就追踪、honor tracker
3. 个人账本/台账系统：SQLite 台账、self-hosted 记录管理
4. 记忆系统：mem0、memos、Everything记忆、 MemOS、Letta、Zep 等 AI 记忆
5. 日记/时间线：开源日记应用、时间线记录
6. 个人 CRM / 人脉台账
7. 自托管的表格/数据库应用：AppSheet 开源替代、NocoDB、Baserow、Appwrite 等
8. 经历整理/简历生成：如 reactive resume、JSON resume

用户是在做"整理竞赛奖状与获奖图片"项目，做了 personal-materials-manager（资料管理器），所以他想看看开源界有什么类似或相关的项目。所以调研方向应该聚焦于：
- 个人资料/资产/成就台账管理
- 图片+元数据管理、个人档案馆
- 自托管个人信息管理
- 个人记忆/经历记录系统

这是一个大范围调研，适合用子代理并行 fan-out。用户明确说"深度调研"、"全部认真收集"。我应该：

1. 规划调研维度（分成几个子代理）
2. 派子代理用 GitHub API / curl 去搜
3. 汇总成对比表格 + UI 卡片

考虑到工具能力，子代理可以用 ops_bash curl GitHub API。GitHub 搜索 API 未认证限 10 req/min，所以要小心。

我要不要用 workflow 工具？规则说：仅在用户明确要求 workflow 或大规模多智能体编排时使用。用户说"深度调研，全部认真收集"，这算大规模调研，但没明确说 workflow。我可以用多个 subagent 并行（规则说：一到两个委托用普通 subagent；大规模 fan-out 用 workflow）。这里是多维度深度调研，属于"fan out across many independent pieces"，用 workflow 合适。但 workflow 子代理能否用 curl？workflow 的 agent() 是子代理，应该有工具。

不过更稳妥：用多个 subagent 并行，每个负责一个方向，明确告诉它们用 curl + GitHub API，不要用 web_fetch。然后我汇总。

让我设计调研维度（6-8 个并行子代理）：

A. 个人知识管理 / 第二大脑 / 笔记（自托管、开源）：Obsidian(闭源但生态)、Logseq、SiYuan、Anytype、AppFlowy、Joplin、Trilium、Atom、Notesnook、Memos、FlatNotes、Notea
B. 个人成就/奖项/履历/证书台账：搜索 GitHub "achievement tracker", "award collection", "certificate manager", "portfolio", "resume", "honor", "credential wallet", "Open Badges"
C. 个人资料/档案/图片资产管理（含元数据、图片）：Photoprism、Immich、LibrePhotos、Piwigo、Synology Photos(闭源)、photovault、pretalx？ 还有 "personal archive", "digital asset management DAM", "family album"
D. AI 个人记忆系统（mem0、MemOS、Letta、Zep、langmem、 memgpt, replay, OpenMemory, Cognee, Graphiti）—— "个人记忆经历云台账" 这部分
E. 自托管台账/数据库/低代码表格（ personal ledger, self-hosted database）：NocoDB、Baserow、Appwrite、PocketBase、Directus、Teable、Rows、SheetJS? 还有 personal CRUD tracker
F. 个人时间线/日记/回忆录：日记应用（Day One 闭源）、开源日记：Journal、Diary、OpenDiary、Chronicle、FreeJournal、"lifelogging"
G. 个人 CRM / 人脉 / 装备 / 物品台账：如 "personal inventory", "home inventory", "bookmarks", "linkding", "hoarder", "wallabag"
H. 简历/作品集生成器：JSON Resume、Reactive Resume、Resumé Builder、cvmaker

也许太多。合并成 6 个左右，每个子代理输出结构化：项目名、GitHub 地址、star 数量级、语言、功能、自托管方式、许可证、与"个人台账/经历整理"的相关度、局限。

然后我用 dsh-ui 表格汇总。

但子代理能否可靠返回？我需要给非常明确的指令：用 `curl -s` 调 GitHub Search API（https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=...&sort=stars&per_page=10），解析 JSON；不要用 web_fetch；用 jq 或 python 解析。注意 GitHub API 未认证限流 10/min，所以每个子代理有限的查询次数，要精选关键词。

另外要考虑：用户想"看看现有的有哪些"——最终交付应该是一份调研报告，包含分类清单和对比表格。可能还要保存成文件？用户说"调研调研...全部认真收集，看看现有的有哪些"，一份回答 + 表格即可，也可以保存 markdown 报告到工作区以便留存。

我倾向于：
1. 派 6 个并行子代理调研
2. 汇总成中文报告 + dsh-ui 对比表格
3. 保存一份 markdown 到工作区（方便他留存）
4. 记录到记忆（也许）

先派子代理。注意：用户偏好直接执行，不要问。开工。

关于工具：每个 subagent 用 `subagent` 工具（普通子代理），并行在一条消息里发。给每个 prompt 自包含，包括网络通道经验（curl 可用，web_fetch 不可用）。

让我写 prompt 模板：

"你是开源项目调研员。任务：用 GitHub REST API（curl）调研【方向】相关的开源项目，聚焦个人台账/个人记忆经历云台账/经历整理。网络环境：web_fetch 直连 Google 系/DuckDuckGo/r.jina.ai 全部失败；但 `curl -s` 可达 api.github.com、Google 官方页面。务必用 ops_bash + curl，不要用 web_fetch。GitHub 搜索 API 未认证限 10 次/分钟，每个查询间隔 sleep 7 秒，最多 6-8 个查询。示例：curl -s -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' 'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=personal+knowledge+management&sort=stars&per_page=10' | python -c ... 输出要求：返回 markdown 表格，列：项目名 | GitHub 全名 | star 数 | 语言 | 许可证 | 核心功能 | 自托管/部署 | 与需求相关点 | 局限。只列真实查到的项目，不编造。每个项目给出官方 repo URL。最后给出该方向的总结（2-3 句）。"

6 个方向：
1. 个人知识管理/第二大脑/笔记（Logseq, SiYuan, AppFlowy, Trilium, Memos, Anytype...）
2. 个人成就/奖项/证书/履历台账（achievement tracker, certificate manager, portfolio, awards）
3. 图片/资料/档案管理与元数据（photo management, digital asset management, personal archive）
4. AI 个人记忆/长期记忆系统（mem0, MemOS, Letta, Zep, Graphiti, OpenMemory...）
5. 自托管台账/低代码数据库/个人记录系统（NocoDB, Baserow, PocketBase, Teable, Directus, personal tracker）
6. 简历/作品集/时间线/日记（JSON Resume, reactive-resume, timeline, journal, lifelog）

也许拆成 7 个：把简历/时间线/日记单独成方向，把"个人 CRM/物品/书签台账"加进去。

我决定 7 个并行子代理。用户要"深度调研、全部认真收集"，7 个合理。

让我确保每个子代理知道输出要中文、结构化、真实数据。

开始。

另外，我需要检查一下是否有 subagent 数量限制？应该没有。并行 7 个。

写 prompt 时注意：子代理没有当前对话上下文，必须自包含。

好，执行。同时在等待期间我可以自己也做一些调研（比如自己 curl GitHub API 搜几个核心关键词），但规则说不要重复子代理工作。我可以在子代理跑时准备报告框架，但实际还是等结果。

先派子代理。由于 subagent 工具调用后立即返回名字，我可以在同一条消息发 7 个。然后结束回合（因为只剩等待），报告会自动唤醒我。

实际上我可以同时自己也用 curl 查几个特别关键的（比如"personal materials manager"类似项目），但那是重复。还是等。

让我发 7 个 subagent。

注意：subagent 默认继承 cwd，可以用 ops_bash。告诉它们把结果直接返回（final text），不要写文件，避免冲突。

Prompt 详细版（每个方向定制关键词）：

方向1 - PKM：
关键词建议：personal knowledge management, second brain, note taking self hosted, PKM, digital garden, personal wiki
方向2 - 成就/奖项/证书：
achievement tracker, award collection, certificate management, personal portfolio, credential wallet, honor roll, skill tracking
方向3 - 图片档案/DAM：
photo management self hosted, digital asset management, personal archive, image metadata organizer, memory album
方向4 - AI 记忆：
AI memory layer, long term memory agent, personal memory system, mem0, knowledge graph memory
方向5 - 自托管台账/低代码：
self hosted database, no code database, personal tracker, NocoDB, Baserow, PocketBase, ledger app
方向6 - 简历/时间线/日记：
resume builder open source, personal timeline, journal app self hosted, lifelog, chronicle
方向7 - 个人物品/人脉/书签台账：
personal inventory manager, contact manager self hosted, bookmark manager self hosted, linkding, hoarder, home inventory

每个子代理要求：至少 8-12 个项目，覆盖不同子类；记录 star 数量级；给出 repo URL。

好，开始。

还要注意 GitHub API 限流。7 个子代理同时调 api.github.com，未认证限 10 req/min 是按 IP 的，可能会互相限流！这是个问题。所有子代理共享同一出口 IP。7 * 6 = 42 请求，会撞限流。

解决方案：
- 告诉每个子代理限制查询次数（3-4 次），并在查询间 sleep 7 秒。
- 但 7 个并行仍然会撞。
- 或者：让子代理用 GitHub 网页搜索（curl github.com/search?q=...&type=repositories），不受 API 限流？GitHub 网页搜索可能要登录/有反爬。
- 或者：给子代理错峰启动？复杂。
- 或者：减少子代理数量到 4-5 个，每个用 API 查询但错开。

其实 GitHub Search API 未认证限制是 10 requests/minute per IP。如果 7 个子代理同时发，前 10 个成功，后面 403。子代理可能拿到 403 就失败。

更好的办法：我自己先用 curl 做一批 GitHub API 查询，把原始结果保存下来，然后派子代理基于这些原始数据做分析？但那样子代理就没法自主探索了。

折中：
- 方案 A：让每个子代理用不同渠道：GitHub API + GitHub 网页 + grep.app + 其他搜索引擎（通过 curl）。但记忆说 web_fetch 失败，curl 可达 bing? 记忆说 bing 302 到 cn.bing.com，质量差。
- 方案 B：错峰：先派 3 个子代理，等它们完成再派下一批。但用户要深度调研，时间可接受。
- 方案 C：让子代理优先用 `gh` CLI 如果已认证（可能有 token，限流 5000/hr）。检查 `gh auth status`。如果有 token，就没问题。

让我先检查环境：curl GitHub API 是否可达、是否有 gh token、限流状态。这个很快。

实际上，我应该先做这个检查再派子代理。让我先跑一个命令：
- curl -s https://api.github.com/rate_limit | python parse
- gh auth status 2>&1 | head
- curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://github.com

这决定了策略。先做这个。

用户说不喜反复征求意见，直接执行。好。

让我先检查。
收到，这是个大范围深度调研。我先摸清 GitHub 访问通道和限流情况，再分方向并行扫。

- 喜欢对比表格和 UI 卡片速查
- 不喜欢反复征求意见
